name: swissmetro_custom
description: Swissmetro MNL with observed heterogeneity: business (PURPOSE 3) vs commuter time sensitivity; cost sensitivity by income bracket (reference: under 50k CHF; 50-100k, over 100k, unknown); log cost; first class (train) and luggage (car).

utilities.train: ASC_TRAIN + B_TIME * TRAIN_TT / 100 * (1 + B_TIME_BUSINESS * (PURPOSE == 3)) + B_COST * log(1 + TRAIN_CO * (GA == 0) / 100) * (1 + B_COST_INC_MID * (INCOME == 2) + B_COST_INC_HIGH * (INCOME == 3) + B_COST_INC_UNKNOWN * (INCOME == 4)) + B_FIRST_TRAIN * FIRST
utilities.sm: B_TIME * SM_TT / 100 * (1 + B_TIME_BUSINESS * (PURPOSE == 3)) + B_COST * log(1 + SM_CO * (GA == 0) / 100) * (1 + B_COST_INC_MID * (INCOME == 2) + B_COST_INC_HIGH * (INCOME == 3) + B_COST_INC_UNKNOWN * (INCOME == 4))
utilities.car: ASC_CAR + B_TIME * CAR_TT / 100 * (1 + B_TIME_BUSINESS * (PURPOSE == 3)) + B_COST * log(1 + CAR_CO / 100) * (1 + B_COST_INC_MID * (INCOME == 2) + B_COST_INC_HIGH * (INCOME == 3) + B_COST_INC_UNKNOWN * (INCOME == 4)) + B_LUGGAGE_CAR * LUGGAGE
